how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-zul-gurub-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:8102:completion:0: Be unstoppable, like the molten fronts of Kajaro.
rows.quest:8103:completion:0: Continue in your decimation of the trolls of Zul'Gurub. Hakkar must see that the world will not buckle beneath his indomitable will.
rows.quest:8104:completion:0: <Al'tabim shatters the pebble with a powerful unseen force.>
rows.quest:8104:completion:1: BDo you see? The pebble is what we call a geode. Inside the pebble are powerful crystals that have been soaking in the latent energies from our world. By cutting the pebble in half, I have finally allowed its full potential to be realized. Use it to lay waste to our enemies.
rows.quest:8106:completion:0: Accept this talisman, ⟦1⟧. Accept it and use its power to strike down our mutual enemies.
rows.quest:8106:completion:1: BKnow that around your neck you carry a piece of history. Kezan was once a grand territory of the Zandalar Empire. Alas, the taint of goblin trade princes would force out my proud brothers and sisters.
rows.quest:8106:completion:2: BKezan is now home to the goblin capital of the Undermine; but know that before the taint, it held greatness. Still to this day Kezan is considered sacred land to my people.
rows.quest:8107:completion:0: Draw from the darkness, ⟦2⟧. Embrace the shadows. Let Kezan's Taint supplement your dark meddling.
rows.quest:8108:completion:0: It is only through our combined efforts that we will stop the Soulflayer.
rows.quest:8109:completion:0: Flay the flesh from their corpses. Watch as the shadows consume the Hakkari. Draw power from their fear, ⟦3⟧. Let Kezan's Taint augment this power...
rows.quest:8110:completion:0: See this here seaweed, mon? It be from the South Seas. We just add a little mojo and a little magic and it takes on the properties most suited to its owner.
rows.quest:8110:completion:1: BYou a ⟦4⟧ so it be easy, mon. Just wrap it around your neck and think of nature or squirrels or whatever it be that you people like.
rows.quest:8111:completion:0: The neck piece not be for smokin', mon! You got to use it to fight evil.
rows.quest:8112:completion:0: Now you take the evil trolls in Zul'Gurub and show them what your nature powers can do, mon!
rows.quest:8113:completion:0: ⟦5⟧ mon, it been a good journey. Keep on with the killing and suppressing of Hakkar and he minions.
rows.quest:8116:completion:0: You and Maywiki have something in common, mon. We both be ⟦6⟧! Although, Maywiki is more of a mystic and you be more of a scrub. Still, we both know what the great spirits bring.
rows.quest:8116:completion:1: BAs a gift I give to you this orb to wear around your neck. Look deep inside and see the village of Voodress in the South Seas! Let it lift your spirits!
rows.quest:8117:completion:0: Beware the evil Hakkari spirits, mon. Honestly, they be spooky.
rows.quest:8118:completion:0: Take a look at it now, ⟦7⟧. Voodress come in even clearer now, yea? Let the primal power flow through you, mon.
rows.quest:8119:completion:0: One day, ⟦8⟧, you will be able to use this orb to communicate directly with me. Whenever this battle with Hakkar be over and Maywiki go home. Let us call to the spirits and ask them for that day to come soon.
rows.quest:8141:completion:0: You progress swiftly, young ⟦9⟧. Perhaps it is time to initiate you into the Shera Ali'kh - Zandalari for Death's Hand. For thousands of years we have played the role of assassin for the Zandalar Empire. For too long we have sat idly, allowing the Hakkari to grow in strength. Once more we face Hakkar, but this time without the support of a united ⟦10⟧ front. It is you and your allies who must assist in vanquishing the Blood God and his minions!
rows.quest:8141:completion:1: BWear this talisman and let it assist you in your journeys.
rows.quest:8142:completion:0: There is only one enhancement left that can be placed on the talisman, ⟦11⟧. When the time is right, I shall apply that enhancement.
rows.quest:8143:completion:0: An assassin of your caliber should be given a wide berth. Your foes must learn respect! You will get just that when the enemy sees the glint of Death's Hand - all too late...
rows.quest:8144:completion:0: This is the last time we will speak under the auspices of Shera Ali'kh. You know all that you must. Take the talisman and continue in your slaying. Hakkar must never be allowed to leave Zul'Gurub.
rows.quest:8145:completion:0: Amongst the Zandalarians, the profession of ⟦12⟧ is revered. Our greatest hunters travel to the edge of the Maelstrom to prove their resolution.
rows.quest:8145:completion:1: BFrom the heart of the sea they pull strands of kelp known as Maelstrom Tendrils. The kelp is then woven into a talisman that is enchanted to improve their accuracy and power.
rows.quest:8145:completion:2: BI now grant you a single weaving of the Maelstrom's Tendril. As your bond with Zandalar grows, I shall weave more power into the talisman.
rows.quest:8146:completion:0: There is only one more weave that I will be able to add to your talisman, ⟦13⟧
rows.quest:8147:completion:0: Let them seek atonement at the end of your munitions.
rows.quest:8148:completion:0: Your journey has only just begun, young ⟦14⟧. Perhaps one day you will visit the Maelstrom and glance into the heart of the world.
rows.quest:8148:completion:1: BI wish you power and fortitude!
rows.quest:8181:details:0: My delvings into the Mosh'aru Tablets bear grim news, ⟦15⟧. Hakkar's true form, the god himself, can be born again through the very egg into which you captured him. Yeh'kinya told you it was to contain his evil, but it is to recreate it! The troll has led you astray!
rows.quest:8181:details:1: BGo to Yeh'kinya and demand the egg from him. Pray that it is not too late to stop Hakkar's return!
rows.quest:8181:completion:0: So, you have been speaking with that old dwarf Ironboot and uncovered the lost Mosh'aru Tablets, have you? That meddling prospector...
rows.quest:8181:completion:1: BNo matter. It is too late to save this world. Hakkar has been reborn, and even now grows in power... deep in the ancient troll kingdom of Zul'Gurub! He has come! And he will rule in blood and terror!
rows.quest:8181:completion:2: BThank you, ⟦16⟧. Your help has sped the return of the Soulflayer!
rows.quest:8183:obj:0: Bring the Heart of Hakkar to Molthor on Yojamba Isle.
rows.quest:8183:details:0: The Heart of Hakkar burns from within. Although the Soulflayer is defeated, the kernel of his power yet remains in this cursed organ.
rows.quest:8183:completion:0: Ah, the Heart of Hakkar. So the Soulflayer has been slain! Our world is saved!
rows.quest:8183:completion:1: B⟦17⟧, your service to us cannot be overstated. You truly are a hero of this realm!
rows.quest:8201:obj:0: String 5 Channeler's Heads, then return the Collection of Troll Heads to Exzhal on Yojamba Isle.
rows.quest:8201:details:0: It is true. Hakkar now dwells in Zul'Gurub, bathing in the power of our gods. Enthralled high priests now channel the energies of our most sacred divinities into the Soulflayer, who will soon have a strength beyond any being of ⟦E1⟧. He must be stopped!
rows.quest:8201:details:1: BTake this sacred cord, and string through it the heads of the high priests responsible for channeling our gods' energy.
rows.quest:8201:details:2: BWhen you have done this, return to me.
rows.quest:8201:completion:0: You gained the heads! You have halted the plundering of our gods' power, and weakened Hakkar!
rows.quest:8201:completion:1: BYour actions are truly heroic, ⟦18⟧. May the heads of these troll thralls plead to you for mercy long after their blood chills.
rows.quest:8227:obj:0: Return Nat's Measuring Tape to Nat Pagle in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8227:details:0: Amongst the shattered fishing lures and tackle is a rolled, silken measuring tape. Attached to the tape is a label that reads:
rows.quest:8227:completion:0: Why, you found my favorite measuring tape! I love this tape! I measured some of the biggest fish I ever caught with it...
rows.quest:8227:completion:1: BBut, I lost this tape in Zul'Gurub... you've been to Zul'Gurub? Did you see the fabled Gahz'ranka?
rows.quest:8227:completion:2: BWell... do you want to catch him?
rows.quest:8240:obj:0: Destroy any one of the Hakkari Bijous found in Zul'Gurub at the Altar of ⟦E3⟧ on Yojamba Isle. When done, speak with Vinchaxa nearby.
rows.quest:8240:details:0: The destruction of the various Hakkari Bijous is of grave importance to us, so much so that we welcome outsiders of the tribe to do so for themselves!
rows.quest:8240:details:1: BTake any one of the bijous that you find in Zul'Gurub to the Altar of ⟦E3⟧ and destroy it. For this one time alone, I will give you an additional Honor Token from our tribe; this is above and beyond what you would normally receive.
rows.quest:8240:details:2: BWitness for yourself the blessings of ⟦E3⟧!
rows.quest:8240:completion:0: Excellent... each bijou we wrest away from the Blood God's minions is one step closer we all are to finally defeating them once and for all. You bring honor to the Zandalar - and yourself - through your noble actions.
rows.quest:8240:completion:1: BRemember ⟦19⟧, you may always destroy the bijous you find in Zul'Gurub at the altar. For each one, you will gain recognition and an Honor Token! Just remember to have an open space in your inventory if you don't have one of the tokens already.
